title: Beats and Pokémon team up on a Pikachu speaker that sells out fast
title_zh: Beats 和宝可梦联名出皮卡丘音箱，很快就卖断货了

image.credit: Photo by Amr Taha™ on Unsplash
image.author: Amr Taha™

lead: Beats has released a special-edition Pill speaker with Pokémon, and it sold out almost immediately. The collaboration goes well beyond slapping two logos together, with packaging and details designed to delight collectors.
lead_zh: Beats 推出了和宝可梦联名的特别版 Pill 音箱，几乎一上市就卖光了。这次联名远不只是把两个 logo 放在一起，包装和细节都专门为收藏者下了功夫。
preview: The special-edition Beats Pill, made with The Pokémon Company International, went on sale on October 13 through Apple's online store and Bea
preview_zh: 这款 Beats 与宝可梦国际公司合作的特别版 Pill 于 10 月 13 日正式发售，渠道仅限苹果官网商店和 Beats 抖音官方旗舰店。它很快就售罄了，现在想按原价买到并不容易。Beats 向来擅长联名，但这次之所以格外引人注目，是因为它投入的新设计之多。
paragraphs: The special-edition Beats Pill, made with The Pokémon Company International, went on sale on October 13 through Apple's online store and Beats' official Douyin flagship store only. It quickly sold out, and finding one at the original price is now difficult. Beats is no stranger to collaborations, yet this one stands out for the sheer volume of new design work it involved.

The attention to detail begins with the parcel itself. Inside the shipping box sits a Beats Pill surrounded by lightning motifs, flanked by the official release date. A card featuring Pikachu and a Poké Ball carries an invitation to try the product. The packaging, split between electric yellow and grey, displays Pikachu and Mimikyu, whose ears can be folded up to turn the box into a stand—a first for Beats.

The speaker's front grille depicts the same two characters, with metallic lightning bolts embedded rather than printed, lending the image a three-dimensional quality. Beats has also introduced a lanyard with a charm showing a Poké Ball on one side and the Beats 'b' on the other, the first Pill to come with such an accessory. Stickers tucked among the paperwork add a small extra surprise.

Chris Thorne, Beats' chief marketing officer, described Pokémon trainers as one of the world's most passionate communities and called the product a union of two deeply rooted cultural brands. The collaboration, he suggested, points to what future partnerships might achieve. Beyond the styling, the Pill retains its silicone body, IP67 dust and water resistance, one-touch pairing and Find My support.

Its custom acoustic system delivers deep bass and crisp mids and highs, and wired USB-C playback supports lossless audio; two units can pair for stereo. Battery life reaches 24 hours, and the special edition costs the same as the standard model. Resellers, however, are asking two or three times the retail price, so buyers should weigh the premium carefully.
paragraphs_zh: 这款 Beats 与宝可梦国际公司合作的特别版 Pill 于 10 月 13 日正式发售，渠道仅限苹果官网商店和 Beats 抖音官方旗舰店。它很快就售罄了，现在想按原价买到并不容易。Beats 向来擅长联名，但这次之所以格外引人注目，是因为它投入的新设计之多。
细节从包裹本身就开始体现。快递箱里躺着一台 Beats Pill，四周是闪电元素，两侧印着正式发售日期。一张带有皮卡丘和精灵球图案的卡片，邀请大家来体验这款产品。包装盒以电光黄和灰色为主，上面是皮卡丘和谜拟丘，它们的耳朵可以翻起来，把盒子变成立牌——这在 Beats 还是头一回。
音箱正面网罩上同样是这两个角色，金属质感的闪电并非印制，而是嵌上去的，让画面有了立体感。Beats 还首次为 Pill 配了挂绳，挂饰一面是精灵球，一面是 Beats 的“b”标志。夹在纸质文件里的贴纸，则带来一点额外的小惊喜。
Beats 首席营销官 Chris Thorne 称，宝可梦训练家是全球最热情的群体之一，这款产品是“两个深植于文化的品牌强强联手”。他表示，这次合作也预示了未来联名可以走多远。除了外观，Pill 依旧采用硅胶机身，具备 IP67 防尘防水、一键配对和“查找”支持。
它的定制声学系统带来浑厚低音和清晰精准的中高频，USB-C 有线连接还支持无损音频；两台还能无线配对组成立体声。续航达 24 小时，特别版与普通版定价一致。不过代购渠道已经喊出两三倍的价格，买家还是要量力而行。

vocab.note: 商业语境中指品牌联动，比 cooperation 更常用于产品联名
常用被动 sold out，也可说 sell out fast
设计领域指反复出现的装饰主题
常用于描述物体两侧的布置
强调物体嵌入另一物体内部，非表面印刷
lend sth a quality 为固定搭配
tuck sth among/in sth 表示藏在其中
正式用词，比 keep 更书面
形容音质时指干净利落
音频术语，与压缩音质相对
weigh the premium 指衡量溢价是否值得
